phases.title: Algebraic and ordinal preliminaries
phases.description: Homogeneous polynomials, associated graded algebras, divisibility, greatest common divisors, and ordinal arithmetic.

phases.title: Ordinal value and degree
phases.description: The ordinal value, principal representatives, translated truncations, the convolution formula, and multiplicativity of the degree.

phases.title: Cantor–Bendixson ranks of supports
phases.description: Cantor–Bendixson ranks of closures of supports, their multiplicativity, and their relation to the ordinal value and degree for real exponents.

phases.title: Algebraic independence in graded rings
phases.description: Transfinite degree induction for algebraic independence in associated graded algebras.

phases.title: Translated truncations
phases.description: The translated-truncation calculation for real exponents, including its derivation and Leibniz rule.

phases.key: Limit ordinals in the degree induction
phases.title: Limit ordinals in the degree induction
phases.description: The induction step and partial-derivative decomposition when the degree is a limit ordinal, for real exponents.

phases.title: Principal RV-elements
phases.description: The associated graded description of the ring of principal RV-elements and algebraic independence of its minimal homogeneous generators.

phases.title: Polynomial presentations
phases.description: Polynomial presentations of the ring of principal RV-elements, the associated rings of RV-elements, the ring of germs, and rings of generalised power series.

phases.key: Primality and factorisation for real exponents
phases.title: Primality and factorisation for real exponents
phases.description: Greatest common divisors, primality, irreducibility, and factorisation for generalised power series with non-positive real exponents.

phases.title: Reduction along Archimedean classes
phases.description: Reduction to real exponents at the leading Archimedean class, followed by induction when the support meets finitely many Archimedean classes.

phases.title: Refinement and transfinite induction
phases.description: Four-factor refinement after restriction to one Archimedean class, followed by transfinite induction from the case of finitely many classes.

phases.key: A cut criterion for Cauchy completeness
phases.title: A cut criterion for Cauchy completeness
phases.description: An order-theoretic criterion for Cauchy completeness.

phases.title: Bounded generalised-power-series integer parts
phases.description: The refinement property for bounded generalised-power-series integer parts and its saturated-group consequences.

phases.title: Surreal numbers and omnific integers
phases.description: Primality and refinement for omnific integers, transported to Conway’s formulation.
